name: Ridhaan
player_statement:
A complete player, Ridhaan has made a big mark in cricket. With 10 turns at the crease, they've hit a top score of 40*, with an average of 14.25 and a quick strike rate of 126.67. Their knack for hitting big shots is evident with 6 sixes and 1 fours.

Equally good at bowling, they've bowled 15.0 overs, taking 7 wickets at an economy rate of 9.40. Despite a few wides, their accuracy is top-notch, making them a key player for their team.
